classification.difficultyReason: Combine two marked right angles and a given angle using a revolution, then find the reflex angle.

content.prompt:
Find $\angle AOD$ in the diagram to the right.

Also give the size of reflex angle $\angle AOD$.

spec.description: Four rays from O, with OA upward, OB rightward, OC downward-left and OD upward-left. Independent square markers show AOB and COD are right angles. The lower sector BOC carries the supplied 170° label. Ordinary source blue strokes are reconstructed in house black. Diagram proportions are schematic and are not measurement evidence.
spec.mathematics: The sectors AOB, BOC, COD and DOA form one revolution; AOB=90°, BOC=170°, COD=90°.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens are visible; neither requested angle is supplied.

answer.worked:
$\angle AOB=90^{\circ}$ and $\angle COD=90^{\circ}$ (marked right angles).

$$\begin{align*}\angle AOD+90^{\circ}+170^{\circ}+90^{\circ}&=360^{\circ}\\\angle AOD&=360^{\circ}-90^{\circ}-170^{\circ}-90^{\circ}\\\angle AOD&=10^{\circ}\end{align*}$$
Angles in a revolution at $O$ add to $360^{\circ}$.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Reflex }\angle AOD&=360^{\circ}-10^{\circ}\\\text{Reflex }\angle AOD&=350^{\circ}\end{align*}$$
